_rjgc_comment: Royal Jordanian Geographic Centre (RJGC). All optional: the JTM grid reference and the public geoportal/order links work with none of these set. RJGC_TILE_URL is an XYZ template using {z}/{x}/{y} and is only needed to show the Centre's own basemap, which requires an agreement with them. JTM_DATUM_SHIFT takes the official 'dx,dy,dz' metres for WGS84 -> Jordan datum; leave empty until RJGC supplies them, and the app will label the conversion as unofficial.
